{{Top|leg}}
'''Directional-repulsorlift steering''' was a type of [[Engine/Legends|engine]] that could be used in [[Airbus/Legends|air buses]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|13:3:28]], a study by [[Rhinnal State Medical Academy|Rhire Medical Academy]] found several species on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to be at risk of disease due to air pollution; the study accordingly recommended that older air buses with [[propellant-based lateral thruster]]s be replaced with more modern variants equipped with directional-[[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] steering.<ref name="HNN 49">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|life/13328_4.html|Study: Pollution Standards Still Endanger Many}}</ref>
